Description.DefaultText:
Caught through mosquito bites.

Cyclical disease that can make you feel tired, give you general pain, cause hydration loss, headaches and confusion.
Description.Text: 蚊虫叮咬导致。\n\n周期性疾病，会让您感到疲倦、全身疼痛，导致脱水、头痛和迷乱。
